title: Two narrators, one walkthrough
goal: Show that a walkthrough can hand off between voices: a storyboard voice every step inherits, and a step that names its own.
audience: Someone deciding how to narrate a walkthrough with more than one speaker.

steps.narration: Every step inherits the voice the storyboard names. This one does, so you are hearing the default narrator.
A step can name its own voice instead. Nothing else changes: the same provider, the same speaking rate, a different speaker.
Any voice the provider offers will do. Run npm run voices to see the list, with the gender and character of each.
A step can change the rate too, without naming a voice at all. This sentence is spoken a little quicker than the rest.
An override lasts one step. This one says nothing about a voice, so it is back to the storyboard's narrator.
